lgb.set_log_level(lgb.INFO)
if "logging" in dir(lgb):
    lgb.logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)


# Suppress progress output
class SilentProgressCallback:
    def __init__(self):
        return

    def before_fit(self, epoch, num_total):
        pass

    def after_fit(self, epoch, num_total):
        pass

    def before_valid(self, epoch, num_total):

        pass

sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

submission_template_cols = sample_submission.columns.tolist()
target_col = "Cover_Type"

# Identify feature columns
feature_columns = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != target_col and col != "Id"]
X_train_full = train_df[feature_columns].astype(np.float32)
y_train_full = train_df[target_col].astype(int)

# Prepare test features
X_test = test_df[feature_columns].astype(np.float32)

# Split for hold-out validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

# LightGBM Parameters

val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": num_classes,
    "metric": "binary",
    "verbose": -1,
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model with full training data

    train_data,

    valid_sets=val_data,

)
